input.rationale: Section 12 is materially one-sided. Client's indemnity (§12a) is broad, covering breach of the Agreement, System/Credit Repository defaults, the Web Site and products sold from it. TrueLink's indemnity (§12b) is limited to its own breach of this Agreement or failure to perform, and there is no third-party IP infringement indemnity anywhere in the document (searches for "infringement"/"intellectual property" return only the Client warranty in §8e and the licence restriction in §2). It therefore fails the fallback as well (no IP indemnity, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies) and approaches walk-away territory. We add a TrueLink defend-and-indemnify obligation for third-party IP claims, TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client Content or Credit Data, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law (preferred position, so no 3x super-cap is volunteered).

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink IP/misconduct indemnity with notice, control and cooperation procedure; narrow Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of law.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement claims and for TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused data breaches and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and narrowed our own indemnity to Client Content and our breach of law.

ops.text: TrueLink shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Client and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Credit Data caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. As a condition to indemnification under this Section 12, the indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.

ops.oldText: (i) any claim arising out of any breach by Client of this Agreement, (ii) any claim or demand resulting from any act or omission by Client or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client which constitutes a breach of or default by TrueLink under any System Agreement or Credit Repository Agreement, which breach or default has either not been cured or cannot be cured within the applicable cure period and the consequences of which is that TrueLink will lose material rights it has pursuant to said Agreements or a violation of any state or federal law, rule or regulation (iii) any claim arising out of or relating to the Web Site or Client Content (including, but not limited to, any claim resulting from any content posted to the Web Site by Client or Client's employees, agent or any customer of Client granted access to the Interface by Client), without regard to any knowledge limitation or qualification that may be contained in this Agreement, and (iv) injury or damage to person or property caused by a product, service, or information, whether or not defective, that is sold, distributed or transmitted from the Web Site.
ops.newText: (i) any claim arising out of or relating to the Client Content, and (ii) any violation by Client of any applicable state or federal law, rule or regulation.
